refutation_attempts.severity: critical (report §3.1 CL-15; the manifest's own "top-severity" label)
refutation_attempts.counter_argument: kala_upaya_get's pact_status='denied_at_promise' might be a broken constant or unimplemented default rather than a genuine verdict. If so, F-110 is not 'two tools reaching opposite conclusions from shared evidence' but merely 'one working forecaster compared against a stub' - which would collapse it into the far milder F-118 class (kala_upaya_get is degenerate) and remove the confidence-laundering charge entirely. A secondary counter: kala_ahead_get's own coverage array discloses promise_gated_forecasting as not_in_corpus and cites SHAD_DARSHANA_BRIEF_v2_0.md §2.2 wave W2/W3, so the gap may be documented, planned work rather than a defect.
refutation_attempts.empirical_test: Called kala_upaya_get on the same chart and same as_of_date=2026-08-15 across all 7 supported domains. A constant would return one value; a real verdict would discriminate. Result: relationship=denied_at_promise, health=denied_at_confirmation, wealth=chain_pending_activation, progeny=chain_pending_activation, spirituality=chain_pending_activation, career=chain_complete, education=chain_complete - FOUR distinct values across 7 domains, including two distinct denial LINKS. Separately re-ran kala_ahead_get(domain='relationship', horizon_years=10): projections[0] still probability_tier='tier_1_high', window 2027-10-20..2030-04-03, probability_statement 'High probability (>=70% convergence, clear activation). Effective convergence: 0.70. Confidence: moderate.' Evidence: evidence/P6_F110_refutation_pact_status_discriminates.json
refutation_attempts.reasoning: The primary counter-argument fails outright: pact_status is demonstrably domain-discriminating, not a default, so 'denied_at_promise' for relationship is a real verdict this server holds. The secondary counter-argument is factually true but does not exculpate - the disclosure lives in a coverage array while the reading/verdict/probability_statement layer, the fields a consumer is designed to read, still narrates an unqualified '>=70%' dated marriage projection over a domain the same server judges is not promised. Per CLAUDE.md §N.6 point 3 and §N.8 that is precisely the shape a disclosure is not allowed to license: an honest gap must downgrade or suppress the claim, not sit beside it. The finding holds at critical.

refutation_attempts.counter_argument: Three counters. (a) resolution_disclosure may in fact be present on the assess_health response and P1 simply inspected the wrong path. (b) The comparison baseline may be fictional - gochara_forecast_get may document a resolution_disclosure contract it does not actually attach, in which case there is no 'dropped' field. (c) Most substantively: the finding's harm framing depends on these five dates being uncalibrated field maxima the system itself does not treat as actionable. If the system's own earned predicate marks them as genuine timing windows, then the response is not misrepresenting them and the relaying risk is overstated.
refutation_attempts.empirical_test: (a)+(b): re-called assess_health and gochara_forecast_get(domain='health', date_range 2027-01-01..2029-12-31). assess_health.gochara_sweep reproduces exactly - 17 windows, 11 loss / 6 neutral / 0 favourable, top five all illness_acute / temporal_shape='point' / is_adverse=true on 2027-08-21, 2028-11-21, 2028-12-13, 2029-04-13, 2029-07-18 - with no resolution_disclosure, no is_timing_window, no probability and no confidence anywhere in the response. gochara_forecast_get DOES attach the full contract to every window including these same five dates. (c): read the earning clause at platform-mcp/src/tools/retrieval/register_gochara_windows.ts:291-360. These five rows return is_timing_window=TRUE - but earned through the temporal_shape==='point' clause alone, with resolution=null and resolution_source='unavailable'. Evidence: evidence/P6_F119_refutation_resolution_disclosure.json
refutation_attempts.reasoning: Counters (a) and (b) fail on direct measurement: the field is absent from assess_health and demonstrably present on the sibling surface, so it is genuinely dropped in projection. Counter (c) lands partially and earns a REFINEMENT of the finding's wording, not its retraction: the rows are not marked non-actionable by the system - they are marked is_timing_window=true - but that true is earned by SHAPE alone, with resolution unavailable, which is itself a §N.8 proxy rather than a resolution measurement. Either way the primary defect is untouched: five single-day acute-illness dates two-to-three years out are served with zero disclosure, zero probability and zero confidence, over a calibration plane that reports n_events=0 / skill_score=null (F-140). Recommend the finding's mechanism paragraph be edited to say 'the disclosure is dropped, and at source it is a shape-earned true over resolution=null' rather than 'uncalibrated field maxima'.

refutation_attempts.severity: TIER1-CORRECTNESS (report §3.1 CL-07; the live instance of the R24 nodal census failure)
refutation_attempts.counter_argument: Three counters. (a) Methodology: if Rahu/Ketu are excluded from the gochara engine altogether, their absence from the marriage window proves nothing about 5th/9th TRUNCATION specifically and the finding's mechanism is misattributed. (b) The audit's own astrology may be wrong - Ketu@Leo may not actually aspect natal Venus and Rahu@Aquarius may not actually aspect the 7th, in which case the 'live distortion' is manufactured. (c) Strongest: the nodal 5/9 aspect is LATER-tradition doctrine, not BPHS. primitives.py's SPECIAL_DRISHTI_DEG comment cites BPHS Ch.26 as its authority, so serving nodes at the universal 7th only may be a defensible deliberate doctrinal position rather than a defect - making F-52 an auditor preference dressed as a correctness failure.
refutation_attempts.empirical_test: (a) SQL over kala_gochara_windows.term_breakdown->'activity_terms' for chart 482012f1: Rahu contributes 85 drishti_contact terms and Ketu 87 (plus eclipse_degree, kakshya and ingress terms). The nodes participate fully - they are truncated, not excluded. (b) Verified the angular arithmetic against live data: natal Venus sign = Sagittarius (chart_facts VEN graha_position.sign), lagna Aries so 7th house = Libra; kala_now_get gochara_dual_reference for 2026-08-15 gives transit Rahu Aquarius 5.566 and Ketu Leo 5.566. Ketu's 5th from Leo = Sagittarius = natal Venus. Rahu's 9th from Aquarius = Libra = the natal 7th. Both land exactly as claimed. Re-ran gochara_activation_get(event_class='marriage', as_of_date='2026-08-15'): one window, 18 activity_terms, transit planets Moon 9 / Sun 4 / Mars 2 / Venus 2 / Jupiter 1 - zero Rahu, zero Ketu, and the strings 'Rahu'/'Ketu' appear nowhere in the response. (c) Read primitives.py:184-195 (no nodal entry, _DEFAULT_DRISHTI_DEG=[180.0]) and w30_nodal_drishti.py's docstring. Evidence: evidence/P6_F52_refutation_nodal_aspect.json
refutation_attempts.reasoning: Counters (a) and (b) fail on direct measurement - the nodes demonstrably participate in drishti_contact elsewhere, so the marriage window's silence is truncation; and both angular claims verify exactly against live natal and transit data. Counter (c) has genuine doctrinal force and exposes a real nuance the finding does not carry: w30_nodal_drishti.py's own docstring states plainly that nodal 5/7/9 is attested only in later tradition (Phaladeepika c.16th century, Saravali, later Parashari sub-commentaries) and is NOT in original BPHS, so primitives.py's BPHS Ch.26 citation is textually defensible on its own terms. It nonetheless does not overturn the finding, on three grounds: (1) this same codebase already grants nodal 5/9 on a live surface (ga_structural_writer.py's NODE_PARASHARI_ASPECTS={5,7,9}, served through ganita_structural_get), so the four aspect tables are mutually inconsistent under any doctrine - some surfaces tell this chart the nodes aspect the 5th and 9th and others do not; (2) R24 is a binding project ruling mandating nodal 5/7/9 full-strength, not an auditor preference; (3) w30_nodal_drishti exists in engine.py as the intended compensator and leaves no trace in served window data (F-21). Recommend adding the later-tradition provenance to the finding text so the classical claim is stated at its true strength.

p6_conclusion: No finding in the 15% sample was contradicted by fresh execution and none is removed. Seven non-removing audit-integrity defects were found and are recorded above: one wrong-package citation (F-09), one set of stale numeric figures (F-56, drifted the wrong way), one overstated mechanism (F-58), one misattributed verbatim quote (F-108, propagated from the P1 evidence file), one non-executable reproduce_cmd (F-109), one data-dependent instance that could not be re-observed (F-130), and one self-inflicted off-by-one that P6 resolved outright (F-72, marker closable). All three top-severity findings survived deliberate refutation; two of the three earned a wording refinement, and in both cases the refinement makes the finding more precise without reducing its severity.
